rubrics.justification: Describes a full blastocyst with plausible A-grade ICM and looser B-grade TE, consistent with 2AB; notes image limitations and avoids major fabrication, though zona/hatching details are limited and some visual certainty is overstated from a single image.
Integrates age, BMI, tubal factor, AMH/FSH, prior IVF failure, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis in a clinically meaningful way.

Overall logic is clear and structured, with probability estimates tied to embryo grade and patient factors; minor issues include somewhat pessimistic weighting of 8.3 mm lining and prior single failed cycle, and slight inconsistency around prognosis strength.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice: supports single embryo transfer, routine luteal support, and avoids unsupported add-ons; minor deviations include overemphasis on borderline lining concerns and somewhat conservative implantation estimates for a 28-year-old.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer and future planning, including SET, review of transfer/endometrial factors, cavity assessment, sperm workup if repeated poor outcomes, and restrained use of PGT-A.
